verdict.rationale: The Agents SDK is an open-source Python/JS library (not a hosted SaaS) that developers install and run entirely within their own infrastructure via the Runner class, and it is explicitly provider-agnostic (works with OpenAI or 100+ other LLMs), meaning the core product can be run fully self-hosted with no mandatory dependency on OpenAI's cloud. missing for 10: an explicit self-hosting/deployment guide, confirmation that tracing/telemetry can be fully disabled or self-hosted (only an env var to turn tracing off is documented), and independent hands-on confirmation of running it in a fully air-gapped/self-hosted setup.
